title: Support playback of RTP/IuUP/AMR(-NB) packets
description:
Allow playing IuUP over RTP streams containing AMR narrowband payload.
Support for AMR-WB or other formats is left as a TODO for the future, since some networks operate solely with AMR-NB.

`__attribute__((packed)` is a GCC extension and not supported on MSVC, possibly other compilers.
@johnthacker I submitted https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17592 with a proposal regarding this topic.

changed this line in [version 12 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17326/diffs?diff_id=1147540467&start_sha=22d58d7214e99b9b718893c96c0342912b06d9ff#98d68a00a74b3f1fbe26797c71e22ea34e99d125_49_29)
As above.
And why does it need to be packed?

well, if you have multiple consecutive uint8_t in a struct and don't pack it, the compiler on many architectures will put 3 bytes of padding between each successive uint8_t.  That doesn't work for defining on-the-wire packet formats or any data storage formats...

commits_data.title: rtp_media: Support playback of RTP/IuUP/AMR(-NB) packets
commits_data.message:
rtp_media: Support playback of RTP/IuUP/AMR(-NB) packets

Allow playing IuUP over RTP streams containing AMR narrowband payload.
Support for AMR-WB or other formats is left as a TODO for the future,
since some networks operate solely with AMR-NB.

commits_data.title: rtp_media: Refactor rtp_decoder_t creation and lookup
commits_data.message:
rtp_media: Refactor rtp_decoder_t creation and lookup

Move rtp_decoder_t creation and lookup to helper functions, so it can be
called from several places in the future.
This will be needed once we add RTP/IuUP/AMR playback support, since
we'll need to hook an intermediate code path to pass trhough the IuUP
frame and then generate AMR frames from the AMR IuUP payload which the
AMR decoder can digest.

commits_data.title: rtp_media: Make decode_rtp_packet_payload() static
commits_data.message:
rtp_media: Make decode_rtp_packet_payload() static

This function is not used anywhere other than in the same file, hence
mark it as static to ease understanding the whole rtp_media code.

commits_data.title: packet-iuup: Add header file packet-iuup.h
commits_data.message:
packet-iuup: Add header file packet-iuup.h

Some of these will be needed by ui/rtp_media module
later on in order to be able to feed RTP/IuUP/AMR payload
to the RTP player.

commits_data.title: packet-{rtp,iuup}: Add field in rtp_info to identify as iuup
commits_data.message:
packet-{rtp,iuup}: Add field in rtp_info to identify as iuup

This can be used later on by the RTP decoder/player to easily identify
IuUP payload inside RTP and have special logic to decode AMR inside it.

commits_data.title: packet-amr: Drop struct amr_oa_hdr definition
commits_data.message:
packet-amr: Drop struct amr_oa_hdr definition

Since packed structures are not accepted, this structure lost its
purpose, hence drop it since it won't be used by follow-up patches.
